design: walk-forward: for each season S in 2016-2025, both models train on seasons < S only (recency half-life 6 anchored at S-1, method-of-moments shrinkage per band x position, verbatim phase3i methodology); <2 prior drafts falls back to league priors and counts as low-confidence

logloss.note: delta = baseline - profiles; positive means the franchise component adds real predictive information

hit_rate_top1.note: top-1 is a blunt metric here - both models usually name the modal position (RB/WR); log-loss is the honest headline

provenance.source: out/picks.csv (13 league drafts) via the committed phase3i methodology
